We offer innovative machines and systems for the individual requirements of your industry. KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers its own digital solutions in addition to a wide range of products and services of its sector. We are regarded as a technological pioneer in the textile machinery industry. The name goes back to the company founder Karl Mayer. This is what the KARL MAYER brand represents in the textile machinery manufacturing industry. With our machine portfolio, we serve a broad spectrum of solutions for textile machine construction:. The organisation into business units helps us to place customer benefit at the centre of our solutions and to live entrepreneurship.
